{"sections":{"overview":"Sealing head: a pneumatic heat-sealing head closes on a pouch, holds for the dwell time at the set temperature, then opens.","sequence":"- Operator loads a pouch and presses both two-hand buttons within 0.5 s.
- Sealing head down; wait for head-down sensor.
- Hold for the dwell time (set on the HMI) at the seal temperature.
- Sealing head up; wait for head-up sensor.
- Unwinder runs while the head is up to index the film.","safety":"- E-stop and light curtain into a safety relay; safety relay OK to the PLC.
- Two-hand start (type IIIC) for each cycle.
- Light curtain interrupted: head returns up, cycle stops.","guarding":"- Light curtain across the sealing station.","homing":"- Power-up: head up, heater off until the operator starts.","modes":"- Auto and Manual from the HMI; Manual jogs the head up/down.","motion":"- M1 unwinder motor, 0.5 HP, 480 VAC 3-phase on a VFD with a speed reference from the PLC.","pneumatics":"- Sealing head cylinder, double solenoid (down / up), head-up and head-down sensors.
- Air pressure switch.","sensing":"- Film roll low sensor.
- Seal heater thermocouple through a 4-20 mA transmitter, 0–300 °C.
- Heater over-temperature limit.","operator":"- Two-hand buttons, Stop, Fault reset, running and fault lights.
- C-more 7" touch panel: seal temperature and dwell time setpoints, alarms.","alarms":"- Head not down / not up within 3 s.
- Heater over-temperature.
- Unwinder VFD fault.
- Low air pressure.
- Film roll low (warning).","utilities":"480 VAC 3-phase, 60 Hz. Plant air. NEMA 12. US.","other":""},"questions":["What heater power and voltage?","Seal temperature range and default dwell time?"],"summary":"Organized the sealing head description."}
